blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — A magnitude 5.5 earthquake struck off the coast of Sarangani, Davao Occidental, at 7:43 a.m. on Wednesday, Oct. 28, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). Phivolcs data showed that the tectonic quake occurred nine kilometers southwest of Balut Island in Sarangani town, at a depth of 10 kilometers. […]...
